table.retrieve:
SELECT
	itemname= item.name, 
	headerno=max(srledger.headerno),
	dbo.users.username,  
	accname = accounts.name, 
	dbo.srledger.srinvcode,   
	dbo.srledger.saleinvcode, 
	dbo.srledger.date,   
	dbo.srledger.discperc,   
	dbo.srledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.srledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.srledger.salestax,   
	dbo.srledger.remarks,   
	looseqty = Sum(dbo.srdetail.looseqty),   
	packqty  = Sum(dbo.srdetail.packqty),   
	icode = Max(dbo.srdetail.icode),   
	srprice = Max(dbo.srdetail.srprice),   
	discperc = Max(dbo.srdetail.discperc) ,
	unitsalestax=max(srdetail.unitsalestax),
	itemgstperc=max(srdetail.gstperc),
	invgstperc=max(srledger.invgstperc1),
	reprintingcounter=max(srledger.reprintingcounter),
	patientname=(select name from patient where patientcode=max(srledger.patientcode)),
		regno=(select regno from patient where patientcode=max(srledger.patientcode)),
	rowid = MAX(srdetail.rowid)
FROM 
	dbo.srledger,   
	dbo.srdetail,  
	customer, 
	accounts, 
	item,
	users 
WHERE 
	( dbo.srledger.srinvcode= :ra_InvCode ) AND 
	( dbo.srledger.srinvcode= dbo.srdetail.srinvcode) AND 
	( dbo.srledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode) AND 
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode) AND 
	( dbo.srledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode) AND 
	( srdetail.icode = item.icode ) 
GROUP BY 
	dbo.srledger.srinvcode, 
	dbo.srledger.saleinvcode, 
	dbo.srledger.date, 
	dbo.srledger.discperc, 
	dbo.srledger.flatdisc, 
	dbo.srledger.misccharges, 
	dbo.srledger.salestax, 
	dbo.srledger.remarks, 
	dbo.item.name, 
	dbo.accounts.name, 
	dbo.users.username
ORDER BY
	RowID

objects.name: c_sumitemleveltaxval
objects.expression: sum( unitsalestax * looseqty  + Round( c_amount  * 0.01 *  itemgstperc , 2) for all)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(sum( c_amount ) * (1 -  srledger_discperc  * .01) -  srledger_flatdisc  +  srledger_misccharges  +  srledger_salestax , 0)  + Round(Round( (Round( sum (c_amount for all) * (1 - 0.01 *  srledger_discperc ) ,2) -  srledger_flatdisc ) * 0.01 *  invgstperc  ,2 )  + sum( c_salestaxval for all) ,0)

objects.name: c_totalsalestax
objects.expression: Round( (sum (c_amount for all) * 0.01 *  srledger_discperc) * ( 1 -  srledger_flatdisc ) * (invgstperc  *  0.01) ,2)  + Round(sum( c_salestaxval for all) ,0)
